_comment: config.json is OPTIONAL for granola-sync. The daemon auto-discovers serverUrl + bearerToken from ~/.claude.json and reads the Granola API key from the macOS keychain (service: dent-brain.granola-sync). All sync behavior lives in user/filter.ts (authored via /dent-extensions setup granola-sync): includeFolders declares which Granola folders to pull, filter() narrows. There are no tunables here — the reconcile window is GRANOLA_SYNC_LOOKBACK_HOURS (env, default 48). Override serverUrl/bearerToken here only if auto-discovery can't find them.
